title: Select an open location to begin ordering
description: Verifies that a customer can choose an available restaurant location and continue to the menu.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Select an open location
Verify the menu browsing screen is displayed

title: Open the admin dashboard after signing in
description: This verifies that an admin can authenticate and reach the dashboard with summary counts.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed
Verify summary counts are visible

title: Open the ordering flow from the landing page
description: Verifies that a customer can start ordering from the homepage CTA and reach the location selection step.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the call to action section
Click the call to action to start ordering
Verify the location selection screen is displayed

title: Open a product and add it to the cart
description: Verifies that a customer can inspect a product’s details and add it to the cart from the menu.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Select an open location
Choose a category with available products
Open a product
Add the product to the cart
Verify the cart shows the added item

title: Access the admin area without signing in
description: This verifies that visiting the admin route without authentication shows the login screen instead of the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the login screen is displayed
Verify the admin dashboard is not displayed

title: Browse products in a category
description: Verifies that a customer can filter the menu by category and see only the relevant products.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Select an open location
Choose a category
Verify the filtered products for that category are displayed

title: Manage a location from creation to removal
description: This verifies that an admin can create, edit, toggle, and delete a location from the management screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the locations management area
Create a new location with valid details
Open the newly created location for editing
Update the location details
Toggle the location active state
Delete the location
Verify the location no longer appears in the locations list
Verify the locations list remains accessible

title: Manage a product from creation to removal
description: This verifies that an admin can create, edit, toggle availability, and delete a product from the product management screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the products management area
Create a new product with valid details
Open the newly created product for editing
Update the product details
Toggle the product availability
Delete the product
Verify the product no longer appears in the products list
Verify the products list remains accessible

title: Manage a category from creation to removal
description: This verifies that an admin can create, edit, and delete a category from the category management screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the categories management area
Create a new category with a valid name
Open the newly created category for editing
Update the category name
Delete the category
Verify the category no longer appears in the categories list
Verify the categories list remains accessible

title: Save updated restaurant settings
description: This verifies that an admin can update restaurant configuration fields and keep the saved changes visible in settings.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the restaurant settings area
Update the restaurant name and pricing settings with valid values
Save the settings
Verify the updated settings are displayed
Verify the settings page remains accessible

title: Review submitted orders in the admin area
description: This verifies that an authenticated admin can open the orders list and review submitted orders.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the orders area
Verify the orders list is displayed
Verify submitted orders are visible

title: View a location’s details from the landing page
description: Verifies that a customer can open a location card on the homepage and see its details.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the locations section
Select a location card
Verify the selected location details are displayed

title: Switch the interface to English
description: Verifies that changing the language on a supported page updates the visible interface to English.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle to switch to English
Verify the visible interface is displayed in English

title: Switch the interface to Chinese
description: Verifies that changing the language on a supported page updates the visible interface to Chinese.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle to switch to Chinese
Verify the visible interface is displayed in Chinese

title: Switch the interface back to Spanish
description: Verifies that the language can be changed back to Spanish from another supported language.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the language toggle to switch to English
Click the language toggle to switch to Spanish
Verify the visible interface is displayed in Spanish

title: Switch the landing page language
description: Verifies that changing the interface language on the homepage updates the visible page text immediately.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch the interface language
Verify the page text updates to the selected language

title: Language setting remains available in the order flow
description: Verifies that the language toggle is present in the ordering flow and updates the page text there as well.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Click the language toggle to switch to English
Verify the visible interface is displayed in English

title: See an empty category state
description: Verifies that selecting a category with no available items shows an empty state instead of products.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Select an open location
Choose a category with no available items
Verify an empty category state is displayed

title: Language setting remains available on the menu page
description: Verifies that the language toggle is present on another supported route and updates the page text there as well.

steps.description: Navigate to /menu
Click the language toggle to switch to English
Verify the visible interface is displayed in English

title: Keep unavailable products disabled
description: Verifies that out-of-stock products are presented as unavailable and cannot be added to the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Select an open location
Browse the product grid
Verify out-of-stock products are displayed as disabled

title: Install the app from the prompt
description: Verifies that choosing install from the app prompt leads to the app being added for home-screen use.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the install prompt to appear
Click the install action in the prompt
Verify the app is offered for installation

title: Log out from the admin area
description: This verifies that an admin can sign out and return to the login screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Open the account menu
Sign out of the admin area
Verify the login screen is displayed
Verify the admin dashboard is not displayed

title: PWA install prompt appears when available
description: Verifies that the app surfaces an install prompt on a supported route when the browser makes installation available.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the install prompt to appear
Verify an app installation prompt is visible

title: Prevent selecting a closed location
description: Verifies that a closed restaurant location cannot be selected to start an order.

steps.description: Navigate to /pedir
Attempt to select a closed location
Verify the closed location remains unavailable for selection
